latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the self-improvement skill for continuous agent improvement.
- Captures errors, user corrections, feature requests, knowledge gaps, and best practices in structured markdown logs.
- Provides clear guidelines for when and how to log different types of learnings and errors.
- Supports promotion of important learnings to project-wide memory files (e.g., AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md).
- Designed for easy integration with OpenClaw and other agent platforms.
- Includes reference log entry formats and workflow for resolving and promoting learnings.
